prompt: The attached image is a 244x240 px frame from an animated GIF. Rebuild the scene in 3D with three.js. Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Golden chick</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:244px;height:240px;overflow:hidden;background:white}
canvas{display:block;width:244px;height:240px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xfffdfd);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(244,240);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

function group(parent,name,x=0,y=0,z=0){
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  g.position.set(x,y,z);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}

const chick=group(scene,'golden-chick');
const torso=group(chick,'pear-shaped-body');
const head=group(chick,'head',0,2.03,0);
const eyes=group(head,'eyes');
const mouth=group(head,'bill',0,.24,.462);

function material(color){
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:.94});
}
function oval(parent,name,mat,x,y,z,rx,ry,rz){
  const obj=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,32),mat);
  obj.name=name;
  obj.position.set(x,y,z);
  obj.scale.set(rx,ry,rz);
  parent.add(obj);
  return obj;
}

// The profile runs continuously through the shoulders and into the crown.
const profile=[
  [-1.04,.03,.03],[-.97,.50,.45],[-.74,.85,.67],
  [-.41,1.09,.85],[.03,1.20,.94],[.40,1.19,.94],
  [.79,1.13,.91],[1.17,1.03,.83],[1.48,.89,.74],
  [1.72,.75,.65],[1.91,.595,.55],[2.08,.504,.485],
  [2.31,.477,.462],[2.52,.425,.408],[2.68,.322,.324],
  [2.766,.162,.17],[2.792,.006,.007]
];
const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(profile.map(([y,x,z])=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z)),false,'centripetal');
const chestGold=new THREE.Color(0xffbd32);
const crownGold=new THREE.Color(0xffda3f);
const lowerGold=new THREE.Color(0xeaa13f);
const belly=new THREE.Color(0xffce94);
const buff=new THREE.Color(0xffdcab);
const smooth=THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep;
function bodySection(parent,name,first,last,offset){
  const pos=[],col=[],idx=[];
  const rings=(last-first)*6, slices=96;
  for(let j=0;j<=rings;j++){
    const u=(first+(last-first)*j/rings)/(profile.length-1);
    const r=curve.getPoint(u);
    for(let i=0;i<=slices;i++){
      const a=2*Math.PI*i/slices;
      const x=r.x*Math.sin(a),y=r.y,z=r.z*Math.cos(a);
      pos.push(x,y-offset,z);
      const c=lowerGold.clone().lerp(chestGold,smooth(y,.15,1.75))
        .lerp(crownGold,smooth(y,2.02,2.58));
      const bibTop=1.55-.36*Math.pow(Math.abs(x)/.94,2);
      const bib=smooth(Math.cos(a),.16,.85)*(1-smooth(y,bibTop-.19,bibTop+.12));
      c.lerp(belly,bib*.94);
      c.lerp(buff,.35*bib*Math.exp(-((x/.69)**2)-(((y-1.13)/.47)**2)));
      col.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      if(j<rings && i<slices){
        const k=j*(slices+1)+i;
        idx.push(k,k+1,k+slices+1,k+1,k+slices+2,k+slices+1);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(col,3));
  geo.setIndex(idx);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.97}));
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
}
bodySection(torso,'rounded-breast-and-back',0,11,0);
bodySection(head,'golden-crown-and-cheeks',11,profile.length-1,2.03);

const eyeRim=material(0xbf9d39), eyeMat=material(0x231c0c);
const glint=material(0x8c8666);
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const e=group(eyes,side<0?'left-eye':'right-eye',side*.284,side<0?.443:.487,.327);
  e.rotation.y=side*.61;
  oval(e,'soft-ochre-socket',eyeRim,0,0,0,.084,.108,.044);
  oval(e,'dark-eye',eyeMat,0,.002,.025,.065,.083,.042);
  oval(e,'reflection',glint,-.013,.032,.061,.012,.014,.005);
}
oval(mouth,'lower-bill',material(0xe3972b),0,-.040,.011,.119,.049,.088);
const upper=oval(mouth,'upper-bill',material(0xffbd43),0,.005,.032,.154,.060,.118);
upper.rotation.x=.13;

const wingGold=material(0xf5ab24), cuffGold=material(0xffbf3b);
const tip=material(0x674320),tipLight=material(0x805124);
for(const side of [-1,1]){
  const left=side<0;
  const arm=group(chick,left?'left-wing':'right-wing',side*.84,1.30,.095);
  const folded=oval(arm,'folded-upper-wing',wingGold,side*.071,-.075,.13,.31,.55,.33);
  folded.rotation.z=-side*.33;
  const fore=group(arm,'raised-forewing',side*(left?.06:.27),left?-.065:.006,.40);
  fore.rotation.z=left?-.22:.12;
  oval(fore,'rounded-golden-forewing',cuffGold,0,-.014,.025,left?.292:.246,left?.458:.43,.285);
  const hand=group(fore,'dark-wingtip',left?.048:.073,left?.326:.366,.085);
  hand.rotation.z=left?.51:-.38;
  oval(hand,'brown-feather-pad',tip,0,0,0,left?.208:.157,left?.261:.245,.182);
  oval(hand,'outer-feather',tipLight,side*.084,-.021,-.018,.092,.167,.138);
}

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff8e7,0xe5be88,1.8));
function light(color,intensity,x,y,z){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,intensity);
  l.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(l);
}
light(0xfff5da,1.48,-3,6,4);
light(0xffedc7,.68,4,3,1);
light(0xffe8a6,.74,0,4,-4);

const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1.63,1.63,1.6033,-1.6033,.1,40);
ref.position.set(-.046,1.225,8);
ref.lookAt(-.046,1.121,0);
ref.updateMatrixWorld();

const backdrop=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(40,28),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms:{},depthWrite:false,
    vertexShader:`varying float h; void main(){h=position.y;gl_Position=projectionMatrix*modelViewMatrix*vec4(position,1.);}`,
    fragmentShader:`varying float h;void main(){
      vec3 c=mix(vec3(.69,.70,.67),vec3(.995,.982,.991),smoothstep(-.68,-.12,h));
      gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
    }`
  }));
backdrop.position.z=-4;
backdrop.name='white-studio-background';
scene.add(backdrop);

// A subtle screen-door grain gives the small frame its GIF-like finish.
scene.onBeforeRender=(_r,_s,camera)=>{backdrop.visible=camera===ref;};
const grain=`
  float dotPattern=mod(floor(gl_FragCoord.x)+2.0*floor(gl_FragCoord.y),5.);
  float noiseValue=fract(sin(dot(floor(gl_FragCoord.xy),vec2(19.41,63.73)))*7351.53);
  gl_FragColor.rgb+=vec3((noiseValue-.5)*.027);
  if(dotPattern<.5) gl_FragColor.rgb+=vec3(.018,-.021,.004);
`;
scene.traverse(obj=>{
  if(!obj.material)return;
  if(obj===backdrop){
    obj.material.fragmentShader=obj.material.fragmentShader.replace('#include <colorspace_fragment>','#include <colorspace_fragment>\n'+grain);
  }else{
    obj.material.onBeforeCompile=shader=>{
      shader.fragmentShader=shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <dithering_fragment>','#include <dithering_fragment>\n'+grain);
    };
  }
});
function render(t){renderer.render(scene,ref);}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[chick],render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
